title: Expand compiled road world to all five boroughs
acceptance: the same deterministic compiler used for the Manhattan fixture can generate a tile index and road world covering Manhattan, Brooklyn, Queens, the Bronx, and Staten Island without manually modeled street grids
representative road distances, widths, direction/lane metadata, intersections, and grades remain source-derived and meter-scale across the citywide build
borough boundaries, bridge connections, highway ramps, and other major cross-tile/cross-borough links are included in automated connectivity diagnostics
a documented route/audit set demonstrates that representative long routes can be traced through the compiled road graph across borough and neighborhood boundaries
compiler diagnostics surface disconnected components, invalid topology, missing tiles, and unresolved grade-separation cases for correction rather than hiding them
verification: PR #12 production-only head 91b5e502 passed the full map-compiler suite, web runtime check, project health, lint/types/schemas, and Roach coordination on Ubuntu and Windows. A temporary live NYC source smoke also verified current ordered Socrata pagination/schema and counted 104,961 Roadbed features plus 122,263 CSCL centerlines; that network-dependent workflow was removed before integration.

evidence.work: Added deterministic paginated five-borough Roadbed/CSCL acquisition, borough-safe CSCL identity, schema-v2 citywide compilation over the existing T010 elevation path, vertical-level-aware road graph construction, cross-borough/cross-tile/component/structure/vertical diagnostics, representative cross-borough route audits, missing-output checks, per-tile SHA-256/byte metadata, source/provenance documentation, and regression tests. Live current-source verification caught and corrected the NYC API field names boroughcode/streetwidth before merge.
